content_metadata.description: Interview with Alfred Smith, an award-winning athlete, conducted by Barry Every for NUC TV.

qAndA.answer: He won the Athlete Award for the class of 2015.
qAndA.question: What specific award did Alfred Smith win at the camp?

qAndA.answer: He says he 'has to say everything,' highlighting the competition and enthusiasm.
qAndA.question: What does Alfred say he enjoyed most about the camp?

qAndA.answer: He recommends watching 'Call and West Jeff' - later clarified as Edna Karr and West Jefferson, both New Orleans high schools.
qAndA.question: Besides Alfred, which other players does Barry suggest watching at Destrehan High School?

qAndA.answer: He describes two catches by Alfred: one for a touchdown and one for an extra point, both caught 'on his back, in the corner of the end zone.'
qAndA.question: What impressive play by Alfred does Barry describe?

qAndA.answer: He's constantly touching and adjusting his gold medal throughout the interview.
